source.summary: GitHub Actions 'Embedder footprint' runs for the PR #384 Codex review round-3 fix (branch fix/365-eq-face-identity at head 7d553603f9c7495c93877b8914faea5fece452ee — the Own/Borrow leaf of defval_types_equal_modulo_variant_form in runtime/canonical.rs now resolves (eq) faces to the type they denote before comparing resource identities, so a declared variant over (own $r) compares equal to its export ascription written as (option (own $face))) on top of the round-2 tree at ab541d0 (ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45855689145, 45855709460 and 45855730682 against the branch produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series; the four core-jit series in this file are retained from PR #381's campaign (workflow_dispatch runs 45817815567, 45817829767 and 45817843974)
source.derivation: Re-baseline for the PR #384 Codex review round-3 fix (the Own/Borrow leaf of defval_types_equal_modulo_variant_form in runtime/canonical.rs resolves (eq) faces to the type they denote before comparing resource identities), following the round-2 re-baseline at ab541d0. Attribution was isolated against the round-2 tree itself: pull-request run 45846146691 measured the pre-fix head ab541d0 in CI and passed the gate, and the round-3 fix commit 7d55360 — the only change between the two heads — moves only the twelve series of the three configurations that link telomere-component: in release, stripped file +176 B and stripped .text +176 B on all three; in release-size, stripped file +64 B and stripped .text +64 B on all three. Every other series is byte-identical between the two heads. Against the checked-in baseline only the three release stripped file series grow (+176 B each; every .text series and every release-size series measures at or below its retained baseline), so only those three series are re-baselined to the branch measurements and every other baseline is retained, following the established practice of re-baselining growth only. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the three branch samples, and the pull-request run 45854324276 at the same head measured byte-identically once more. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +11.64% (2,433,656 B to 2,716,856 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison. Merge note for the integration with main cc6550bce007ca8d747160778aab6c3e41af272e (PR #381), retained from the round-2 campaign record: the four core-jit series are retained from PR #381's second re-baseline campaign (branch runs 45817815567, 45817829767 and 45817843974; main control runs 45817858119, 45817871880 and 45817883664 on main at 2d653bfae0bd3ac995c17a0d26154f531762d28c), which re-baselined them for the #193 register mapping and the Codex P2 REX fix in movsx_vreg32; against the original #164 baseline those series stand at +8.32% (release stripped file, 1,989,584 B to 2,155,128 B), +7.48% (release stripped .text), +4.57% (release-size stripped file) and +4.24% (release-size stripped .text). The three release stripped file series of the component-linked configurations are from this PR's round-1, round-2 and round-3 campaigns, and every other series is identical in the campaigns' baselines, so the merged file is the union of the re-baselines.
